Places worth taking your time with

A slower afternoon.
A bigger story.

From the streets of Rome to the canals of Venice, Italy invites you to notice the details. Explore a European trip shaped by the places that draw you in.

Imagine your version

Leave a little room for discovery.

A city filled with history, a coastal town, or a few places connected into one journey. Begin with what interests you: food, art, architecture, or simply a change of pace. Sarah’s website features Italy as a source of inspiration.

This page is travel inspiration. Ask Sarah which planning and booking services are currently available for your trip.

Start with a conversation↗

A few things to think about

  • Your places and prioritiesA few must-see stops, experiences you enjoy, and places where you would like extra time.
  • The rhythm of your tripOne destination or several, relaxed days or busy ones, and how often you want to move between places.
  • Your starting detailsApproximate dates, departure city, travel companions, and the budget you would like to discuss.
